storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: Recent Russian strikes in Ukraine have resulted in nine injuries and significant damage to infrastructure, particularly in the Kyiv region. A kindergarten was destroyed, and firefighters responded to a major blaze as the country faces renewed attacks on its energy network. These strikes come just before trilateral talks involving Ukrainian and Russian delegations scheduled to take place in Abu Dhabi next week.
